page.layout: One page of text: running head at top; below it a title line, a numbered heading "XXX.", then a woodcut emblem (illustration, no text inside); below the picture a motto in two lines of verse with a large initial S. No marginal notes.

main_text.l: ST ercora quod porcis, Asinis quod carduus,

page.notes: The woodcut shows a pig eating dung and a donkey eating thistles beneath a tree; no printed text inside the picture. The initial "S" is a large decorative letter joined to "Tercora". The second motto line reads "Barbaries Nostris asinis porcisque Magistris" in italic; the word "Barbaries" is uncertain in the scan and is marked here: Barbaries[?]. The first line's "Tercora" is printed with the S as an initial, so the text reads "Stercora".
